manifest.name: dsh-juzpost
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects the agent to JuzPost, a free social media scheduler with low-cost paid plans, over MCP: list connected accounts, check platform limits, and draft, schedule or publish social media posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress.

bundle.text:
# Patch layer contributed by the dsh-juzpost bundle.
#
# Two rows:
#   1. `juzpost`      - this package's provider plugin. Reads the JuzPost API key
#                       (JUZPOST_API_KEY by default), exposes `ctx.juzpost` with the
#                       MCP endpoint URL and auth header, and registers the
#                       `juzpost` skill that teaches the agent the posting workflow.
#   2. `juzpost-mcp`  - one @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client instance that connects to
#                       the JuzPost MCP server over streamable HTTP and registers
#                       its tools as mcp__juzpost__* (get_context, list_accounts,
#                       schedule_post, ...).
#
# Configuration (override the `juzpost` row in your profile's cordis.patch.yml):
#   apiKeyEnv  - env var holding the JuzPost API key (default: JUZPOST_API_KEY)
#   apiKey     - inline key; prefer the env var or a .env file in $DSH_HOME
#   baseUrl    - JuzPost host (default: https://www.juzpost.com)
#   skill      - register the `juzpost` workflow skill (default: true)
- insert:
    - id: juzpost
      name: dsh-juzpost
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: JUZPOST_API_KEY
        baseUrl: https://www.juzpost.com
    - id: juzpost-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      inject: [juzpost]
      config:
        transport: streamable-http
        serverName: juzpost
        url: !!js ctx.juzpost.url
        headers: !!js ctx.juzpost.headers
        failOnStartupError: false
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          initialDelayMs: 2000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
          maxAttempts: 10

readme.text: A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that connects the agent to [JuzPost](https://www.juzpost.com), a free social media scheduler with low-cost paid plans, over MCP. The agent can list your connected social accounts, check platform limits, upload media, and draft, schedule or publish posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress.

dsh plugin --profile web add "github:juzpost/dsh-juzpost"
```

Then:

1. In JuzPost, open Settings → API keys and create a key (any paid plan).
2. Export it as `JUZPOST_API_KEY` in your shell, or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.env`.
3. Start `dsh web` (restart the profile after installing) and ask the agent to list your connected accounts.

Override the `juzpost` row in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: juzpost
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: JUZPOST_API_KEY   # env var holding the key
    # apiKey: jp_live_...        # inline key, discouraged

Without a key the `juzpost` row logs a warning and the `juzpost-mcp` row registers no tools; dsh still boots.

- `juzpost`: a service with the MCP endpoint URL and `Authorization` header, read by the `juzpost-mcp` row.
- `juzpost-mcp`: one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` instance exposing the JuzPost tools as `mcp__juzpost__*`.
- `juzpost` skill: the posting workflow (check the workspace, pick accounts, check limits, confirm with the user, schedule, report).

Tool reference: [api.juzpost.com/docs](https://api.juzpost.com/docs). Support: support@juzpost.com.
